baseline: 84a0c15c223001411499f396a6a89cc98684d6d3 (C1 merge); measurements against a kernel built from it with the pinned toolchain

loaded_text_rodata_growth_bytes.basis: C1 measured ~10 KiB for qualify path (Rust logic + C adapter + strings) of comparable size; C2 adds a fixed-table state machine, PMM adapter and an opt-in exercise; the C1 20 KiB exception is NOT inherited

bss_growth_bytes.basis: USB.2 design permanent bookkeeping bound; 8 records x ~32 B + accounting + C allow-list

dma_designated_pages_live.basis: USB.2 design: command, event, DCBAA, ERST = 16 KiB

quarantine_records.basis: design quarantine bound 16 KiB DMA; exhaustion fails closed

native_retained_pages_per_opt_in_boot.basis: one deliberate quarantine, retained for the rest of boot

new_page_tables.basis: frames are reached through the existing kernel RAM alias; no devmap mapping

storage.basis: C1 unit costs: kernel 15 MB, 14-boot native matrix 101 MB, R2-B native 43 MB, hosted suites ~80 MB; one-pass plan ~411 MB + one native rerun + 15% margin; not to be raised without owner approval
